svg.text: One Fargate task runs three containers that share localhost. Grafana has no public endpoint; access is through an SSM tunnel.
VPC 10.40.0.0/16 · 2 public subnets · internet gateway (no NAT)
Security group: NO inbound rules · outbound TCP 443 only
ECS service (desired count 1) → Fargate task · awsvpc · 0.5 vCPU / 1 GiB
All three share one network namespace and bind to 127.0.0.1 only.
Storage is ephemeral: metrics and Grafana config reset when the task is replaced.
Orange: images · Pink: SSM / logs (management) · Red dashed: blocked · Black: in-task traffic over localhost
